entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.

events.summary: The sky splits and the Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria begins.
events.quote: The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria had finally begun.

events.summary: Urza convinces many Dominarians to set aside differences and unite against Phyrexia.
events.quote: Urza convinced many Dominarians not only to set aside their differences, but to embrace them.

events.summary: Teferi and Urza agree the Phyrexian portal must be closed, although Teferi wanted no part of Urza's plans.
events.quote: both agreed the Phyrexian portal must be closed.

events.summary: Gerrard smiles as the Phyrexian portals disappear behind the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Gerrard savored a grim smile as the Phyrexian portals disappeared behind the *Weatherlight*.

events.summary: Barrin digs up his daughter's body and realizes the price of his faith in Urza.
events.quote: As Barrin exhumed his daughter's body, he finally realized the full price of his faith in Urza.

events.summary: Barrin makes a funeral pyre of Tolaria for his family.
events.quote: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

events.summary: Barrin waits in vain for Urza to speak.
events.quote: Barrin waited for the nausea to pass or for Urza to say something else. He waited in vain.

events.summary: Urza remarks on the destruction and Barrin chides him.
events.quote: "I knew this day would come," said Urza.

events.summary: Tsabo Tavoc and Gerrard face off.
events.quote: "I think I can kill you," replied Gerrard.

events.summary: Benalia becomes the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexian slayers.
events.quote: Benalia was only the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers.

events.summary: Kavu emerge across Dominaria, the first and strongest from Yavimaya.
events.quote: Kavu emerged all across Dominaria, but the first and the strongest came from Yavimaya.

events.summary: Kavu erupt from the ground as Phyrexians fall from the sky.
events.quote: fountains of kavu erupted from the ground.

events.summary: Elves of Llanowar welcome Benalish soldiers into the forest.
events.quote: For the first time, elves welcomed Benalish soldiers into the forest with something other than arrows.

events.summary: Llanowar rallies around Eladamri's banner.
events.quote: Llanowar rallied around Eladamri's banner and united in his name.

events.summary: Eladamri returns to help Gerrard, repaying the saving of his people.
events.quote: You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate.

events.summary: Tahngarth roars as he repays an enemy for his stay on Rath.
events.quote: Now I'll repay you for my stay on Rath!

events.summary: Teferi tells Urza he has considered the problems of uprooting continents but the alternative is worse.
events.quote: "I have," replied Teferi, "but the alternative is worse."

events.summary: Squee loses his appetite for bugs after meeting Phyrexian battleflies.
events.quote: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

events.summary: Sisay jokes that Squee turned out a good shot.
events.quote: Who knew he'd be such a good shot?

events.summary: Darigaaz decides his foe will be more useful as a weapon.
events.quote: Darigaaz decided his foe would be more useful as a weapon.

events.summary: Serra's warriors ask in horror where their Lady is.
events.quote: Serra's living warriors looked on in horror.

relations.quote: "You think you can stop me?" hissed Tsabo.
Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.
Hanna would give up her own life before she'd abandon the *Weatherlight*.
the full price of his faith in Urza.
